pipeline_families.source_gap: Dedicated doped front-end recipes are not separately listed; do not use undoped results as criteria
The processing relationship between CPC film and inserts is unknown

state_rules.cut: New child ID plus parent interval plus kerf/remainder; intervals do not overlap
state_rules.section: embedded/polished objects cannot be reset to intact originals
state_rules.lamella: FIB child specimens link to their sample/ROI and are not new intact fibres
state_rules.recovery: Function may recover, while compression history remains
state_rules.replacement: Same-material replacements use new IDs and retain the original failed run

quantity_rules: The core and both electrodes have available-length ledgers; unknown does not mean an unlimited source
Eight application devices require enough parent segments or repeated fabrication; one ID cannot be duplicated
The three bare-core demonstrations default to three sibling samples; reserve a sufficiently long child sample for 80cm winding, and fabricate again if there is insufficient length
Retain the original-rod reference separately in STOCK; it cannot be reverse-transformed from the finished product
Allocate separate samples to destructive characterization and strength testing
